manifest.name: dsh-learning-skills
manifest.description: Learning skills for DeepSeek Harness: course notes, conceptual explanations, lecture chapters, and understanding systems through their evolution.

readme.text:
[中文](README.zh-CN.md)

Four skills for Codex and DeepSeek Harness: turn lectures into notes, work through confusing concepts, write self-contained chapters, and understand complex systems through their evolution.

Each skill is a folder of agent instructions. `course-to-notes` also includes scripts for subtitles, video frames, and output checks. You can install any of them on its own. The instructions are mainly in Chinese; you choose the output language.

| What you want to do | Skill |
| --- | --- |
| Find a course that fits your background, or turn a lecture into notes with timestamps and relevant images | [course-to-notes](skills/course-to-notes/SKILL.md) |
| Understand a project, theory, or institution through its key changes and design tradeoffs | [How an Aircraft Carrier Is Built](skills/evolutionary-understanding/SKILL.en.md) |
| Understand why a definition, method, or step in a proof makes sense | [explain-for-understanding](skills/explain-for-understanding/SKILL.md) |
| Write or substantially revise a lecture chapter, including the background needed to follow it | [obsidian-lecture-writing](skills/obsidian-lecture-writing/SKILL.md) |

Install all four as a DSH plugin in your chosen profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:XSY-28/learning-skills
```

In DSH, invoke `/course-to-notes`, `/evolutionary-understanding`, `/explain-for-understanding`, or `/obsidian-lecture-writing`. See the [DSH guide](docs/dsh.md) for prerequisites, examples, and updates.

In Codex, send:

```text
Use $skill-installer to install these paths from XSY-28/learning-skills:
- skills/course-to-notes
- skills/evolutionary-understanding
- skills/explain-for-understanding

Keep only the paths you want. After installation, send a new message using one of the prompts below. If Codex cannot find the installed skill, restart it.

The installer refuses to overwrite an existing skill folder. Back up any local changes before replacing an older copy.

<details>
<summary>Install from the terminal or copy the folders manually</summary>

If your Codex installation has the bundled installer at the standard location:

```sh
python3 "${CODEX_HOME:-$HOME/.codex}/skills/.system/skill-installer/scripts/install-skill-from-github.py" \
  --repo XSY-28/learning-skills \
  --path skills/course-to-notes skills/evolutionary-understanding skills/explain-for-understanding skills/obsidian-lecture-writing
```

Or download this repository and copy the skill folders you want from `skills/` into your configured skills directory. Copy each whole folder, including its references, scripts, metadata, and license.

</details>
The examples below use Codex syntax. In DSH, replace `$skill-name` with `/skill-name`, as shown in the [DSH guide](docs/dsh.md).

readme.section: How an Aircraft Carrier Is Built
readme.text: The Chinese display name is “航母是怎样建成的”; the invocation identifier remains `evolutionary-understanding`. The skill applies to the evolution of complex systems across domains. Both the instructions and software-history guide are available in English and Chinese through their language links.

readme.section: How an Aircraft Carrier Is Built
readme.text:
```text
Use $evolutionary-understanding to explain the major design changes in DSH.
Use its Git history, connect each change to its constraints and tradeoffs,
and distinguish documented history from inference and teaching examples.
```

readme.section: How an Aircraft Carrier Is Built
readme.text: The skill selects changes by their effect on behavior and structure, preserves branches and reversals, and relates them to the current system. Section titles name the concrete change directly. It also applies to theories and institutions; it does not promise faster learning or treat a coherent narrative as evidence of mastery.

```text
Use $explain-for-understanding to explain regularization.
I can take derivatives, but I don't understand why we add a penalty to the loss.
Start with a small example I can calculate by hand.
```

The skill asks Codex to explain what each quantity represents, connect the example to the derivation, and state when the conclusion applies.

```text
Use $course-to-notes to turn the first 10 minutes of the lecture I provide
into Chinese Markdown notes in ./course-notes.
```

The workflow preserves the lecture's teaching sequence, derivations, questions, and meaningful repetition. Notes include source timestamps and relevant images where the material is available; missing or unclear material is reported. You can supply learning records to get chapter-level reading suggestions; without records, prior learning stays unconfirmed.

It reads the full available transcript first, maps the teaching sequence, then checks visuals at relevant source timestamps. Necessary playback can use a supported faster speed, with pauses or slower review for dense derivations and demonstrations. Transcript gaps and unspoken board work still need checking; fewer screenshots do not establish complete coverage. This changes the processing workflow, without guaranteeing a fixed speedup.
If you have not chosen a course, give your background and goal and ask for course recommendations first.

```text
Use $obsidian-lecture-writing in detailed mode to write an introductory chapter on conditional
expectation for someone who knows basic probability. Deliver it in this chat.
```

The skill asks Codex to introduce concepts before relying on them, explain the reasons behind key steps, and review the chapter from a reader's position. To save it in Obsidian, specify your vault and destination file.

Choose `simplify` for a compact, outline-style chapter or systematic review, and `detailed` for step-by-step explanations, worked examples, and necessary prerequisites. Both preserve key relationships and conditions. The mode controls explanation detail, not theoretical depth or topic coverage; individual difficult sections can be expanded without changing the whole chapter. If no mode is specified, the skill uses the current learning purpose and asks only when the distinction materially affects the result. Syntax and formula lookups remain outside this skill in either mode.

These workflows are for learning and teaching. A formula lookup, translation, or formatting fix can stay brief. Automatic skill selection depends on the client; use `$skill-name` when you want to choose explicitly.

The explanation, chapter-writing, and evolutionary-understanding skills have no script dependencies. The course helpers use Python 3.10+ and the standard library; extracting video frames also needs `ffmpeg` and `ffprobe` on `PATH`.

Video access, audio transcription, and Word/PDF export depend on tools available in your agent environment. This repository does not include a video downloader, transcription model, or document converter.

See [validation.md](docs/validation.md) for development commands, test coverage, and what has not been verified. Package and helper-script checks do not establish that generated notes are correct or that a learner has mastered the material.

For a bug report or contribution, include a concrete request, what happened, and what you expected. Keep private notes, learning records, credentials, and third-party course media out of commits.
[MIT licensed](LICENSE). The license covers this repository's original instructions, code, and test fixtures; course materials retain their own terms.

[English](README.md)

四个可用于 Codex 和 DeepSeek Harness 的技能：课程阅读稿、理解式讲解、自足讲义，以及沿关键变迁理解复杂对象的“航母是怎样建成的”。

每个技能是一份供 Agent 读取的指令。`course-to-notes` 还附带字幕解析、视频抽帧和输出检查脚本。四个技能可以独立安装；指令主要用中文，输出语言由你的请求决定。

| 你想做的事 | 技能 |
| --- | --- |
| 按自己的基础选课，或把指定讲次整理成带时间定位和配图的阅读稿 | [course-to-notes](skills/course-to-notes/SKILL.md) |
| 沿关键设计变迁理解项目、理论或制度，分析变化的约束与代价 | [航母是怎样建成的](skills/evolutionary-understanding/SKILL.md) |
| 弄明白一个定义、方法或证明步骤为什么这样写 | [explain-for-understanding](skills/explain-for-understanding/SKILL.md) |
| 编写或实质改写讲义，把读者需要的背景和推理连接补齐 | [obsidian-lecture-writing](skills/obsidian-lecture-writing/SKILL.md) |

在实际使用的 profile 中，将四个技能作为一个 DSH 插件安装：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:XSY-28/learning-skills
```

在 DSH 中调用 `/course-to-notes`、`/evolutionary-understanding`、`/explain-for-understanding` 或 `/obsidian-lecture-writing`。前提、示例与更新方式见 [DSH 使用说明](docs/dsh.zh-CN.md)。

在 Codex 中发送：

```text
使用 $skill-installer，从 XSY-28/learning-skills 安装以下路径：
- skills/course-to-notes
- skills/evolutionary-understanding
- skills/explain-for-understanding

只保留你需要的路径。安装后，发送一条新消息，用下面的示例调用技能；如果 Codex 找不到已安装的技能，再重启。

安装器不会覆盖已有的同名技能目录。替换旧版本前，先备份自己的修改。

<details>
<summary>从终端安装，或手动复制文件夹</summary>

如果你的 Codex 在标准位置提供了内置安装器，可以运行：

```sh
python3 "${CODEX_HOME:-$HOME/.codex}/skills/.system/skill-installer/scripts/install-skill-from-github.py" \
  --repo XSY-28/learning-skills \
  --path skills/course-to-notes skills/evolutionary-understanding skills/explain-for-understanding skills/obsidian-lecture-writing
```

也可以下载本仓库，将 `skills/` 下需要的技能文件夹复制到你配置的技能目录。请复制整个文件夹，包括参考材料、脚本、元数据和许可证。

</details>
以下示例使用 Codex 语法；在 DSH 中将 `$技能名称` 换成 `/技能名称`，见 [DSH 使用说明](docs/dsh.zh-CN.md)。

中文名称为“航母是怎样建成的”，英文名称为“How an Aircraft Carrier Is Built”，调用标识仍为 `evolutionary-understanding`。技能正文与软件历史取证指南均有中英两版，可通过文首语言链接切换。

```text
使用 $evolutionary-understanding，基于 Git 历史讲清 DSH 的关键设计变更。
说明每次变化的约束与代价，区分有记录的历史、推断和教学例子。
```

技能按行为与结构的变化筛选转折，保留分叉和回退，并连接当前系统。章节标题直接概括具体修改。它也适用于理论和制度；不承诺学习提速，也不把叙事连贯视为掌握证据。

```text
使用 $explain-for-understanding 解释正则化。
我会求导，但不明白为什么要在损失函数里加一项惩罚。
先用一个能手算的小例子讲起。
```

技能会要求 Codex 说明每个量的作用，把例子接到推导上，并交代结论的适用条件。

```text
使用 $course-to-notes，把我提供的课程前 10 分钟
整理成中文 Markdown 阅读稿，放到 ./course-notes。
```

工作流要求保留老师的讲授顺序、推导、问答和强调性重复，根据可用素材标注时间、选取配图，并说明缺失或无法核对的内容。提供学习记录后，还会给每章标注学习衔接和阅读建议；没有记录时标为待确认。

默认先读取完整可用字幕，建立讲授顺序与时间索引，再按需定位核对画面。必须播放时可用实际支持的倍速，密集推导和动态演示暂停或降速复查；字幕空档、未口述板书仍要补查，少量截图不能证明完整覆盖。这是处理流程优化，不保证固定提速倍数。

尚未选课时，可以先提供自己的基础和目标，请它推荐课程。

```text
使用 $obsidian-lecture-writing，选择 detailed 档，给只学过基础概率的读者
写一章条件期望的入门讲义。先在当前对话中交付。
```

技能会要求 Codex 在使用新概念前先把它讲清楚，解释关键步骤的理由，再从读者的基础出发检查正文。需要保存到 Obsidian 时，指定知识库和目标文件。

用 `simplify` 编写紧凑、便于扫描的提纲式讲义或系统复习材料；用 `detailed` 展开推理、算例和必要前置。两档都保留关键关系与条件，控制的是解释展开程度，不改变理论深度或主题范围；个别难点可以局部展开，无须切换整篇。未指定时按当前学习目的选择，只有歧义会实质影响结果时才确认。语法与公式速查在两档下都不触发本技能。

这些工作流用于学习和教学。公式速查、翻译和格式修复可以保持简短。自动选择技能取决于客户端；希望明确指定时，用 `$技能名称` 调用。

讲解、讲义和“航母是怎样建成的”技能没有脚本依赖。课程辅助脚本使用 Python 3.10+ 标准库；抽帧还需要 `PATH` 中可用的 `ffmpeg` 和 `ffprobe`。

获取视频、音频转写和 Word/PDF 导出取决于 Agent 环境中可用的工具。本仓库不附带视频下载器、转写模型或文档转换器。

开发命令、测试范围和未验证能力见 [validation.md](docs/validation.md)。打包和辅助脚本检查通过，不代表生成的阅读稿内容正确，也不能证明读者已经掌握。

报告问题或贡献修改时，请提供具体请求、实际结果和预期结果。不要把私人笔记、学习记录、凭据或第三方课程媒体提交到仓库。

采用 [MIT 许可证](LICENSE)，覆盖本仓库原创的指令、代码和测试材料；课程素材仍受其自身条款约束。
